topic.title: Patience Is a Trading Skill, Not Dead Time

research.summary: Patience means allowing the market to reach the conditions you have defined instead of inventing a trade because you feel pressure to act. Waiting can feel boring, especially after a loss or a missed move. But discipline is built when you follow the process even when nothing exciting is happening. Learn to value observation as much as execution.
